headline: Recommended deleting the requirement to publish city fee changes in a local newspaper, by a 3-0 vote.
summary: The meeting covered one item, a proposed change to the city's fee ordinance. The committee recommended deleting the requirement to publish fee changes in a local newspaper, by a roll call vote of 3 in favor and 0 opposed.
decisions: Recommended amending Sec. 28 “Fees” to delete the newspaper publication requirement, 3-0.

plain_text:
O&A Committee October 5, 2026 Page 1 of 1
Ordinances & Administration Committee
Monday, October 5, 2026 – 6:00 p.m.
1st Floor Council Conference Room
9 Dale Avenue
Gloucester, MA 01930
-Minutes-
Present: Chair, Councilor Sean Nolan; Vice Chair, Councilor Frank Margiotta (remote); Councilor 
Marjorie Grace
This meeting was conducted in-person and remotely via ZOOM.
The meeting was called to order at 6:02 p.m.
1. CC#2026-018 (Gross): Amend Ch. 2 “Administration,” Art. 2 “City Council,” Sec. 28 “Fees” by 
DELETING “and published in a local newspaper whenever fee changes or new fees are approved
by the City Council.”
Summary of Discussion: None.
COMMITTEE RECOMMENDATION: On a motion by Councilor Grace, seconded by Councilor Margiotta,
the Ordinances & Administration Committee voted by ROLL CALL 3 in favor, 0 opposed, to recommend
that the City Council amend Gloucester Code of Ordinances Chapter 2 “Administration,” Art. 2 “City
Council,” Sec. 28 “Fees” as follows:
“All fees contained in the city schedule of fees are hereby established and authorized. Said fees may be
modified from time to time by vote of the city council unless the fees are governed and controlled by M.G.L.
The schedule shall be posted on the city website [DELETE] and published in a local newspaper whenever
fee changes or new fees are approved by the city council.”
MOTION TO ADJOURN: On a motion by Councilor Nolan, seconded by Councilor Margiotta, the
Ordinances & Administration Committee voted by ROLL CALL 3 in favor, 0 opposed, to adjourn the
meeting at 6:04 p.m.
Submitted by:  Lynds Jones, Legislative Aide
Documents submitted at the meeting:  None.
Matters appearing on the agenda that are to be continued: None.
